# Coddy

> > Interactive coding education platform offering hands-on programming courses across JavaScript, Python, Java, C++, C#, R, HTML/CSS, and data structures & algorithms.

Coddy provides beginner-friendly to intermediate programming courses with practical, project-based learning. The platform covers web development fundamentals, object-oriented programming, data science tools like Numpy, file handling across multiple languages, and computer science fundamentals including DSA.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Python
- Java
- HTML/CSS
- C++
- C#
- Numpy
- Data Structures & Algorithms
- Object-Oriented Programming
- File Handling
- Web Development
- Data Science
- Beginner Programming
- R Programming
- Control Flow

## Web Development Courses

- [Introduction to JavaScript](https://coddy.tech/courses/introduction_to_javascript): Beginner JavaScript programming course covering language basics
- [Function Declarations in JavaScript](https://coddy.tech/courses/function_declarations_in_javascript): JavaScript functions: declarations, expressions, arrow functions
- [HTML - Beginner site](https://coddy.tech/courses/html__beginner_site): Beginner HTML course: build basic site with images and text
- [HTML/CSS Challenges - Pack I](https://coddy.tech/courses/htmlcss_challenges__pack_i): HTML/CSS practice challenges for frontend skill development

## Python & Data Science

- [Numpy Fundamentals](https://coddy.tech/courses/numpy_fundamentals): Hands-on Numpy course for Python data science numerical computing
- [Is it even or not? || Complete Tutorial for Python Integers](https://coddy.tech/courses/is_it_even_or_not__complete_tutorial_for_python_integers): Python integers tutorial covering fundamentals and operations
- [Data Manipulation in R](https://coddy.tech/courses/data_manipulation_in_r): R data manipulation with dplyr: subsetting, merging, reshaping data

## Java Programming

- [Control Statements in Java](https://coddy.tech/courses/control_statements_in_java): Java control flow course: conditionals, loops, decision-making
- [File Handling in Java](https://coddy.tech/courses/file_handling_in_java): Java file operations course: reading, writing, managing files

## C++ & C# Programming

- [Basics of Classes and Objects in C#](https://coddy.tech/courses/basics_of_classes_and_objects_in_csharp): C# OOP fundamentals: classes and objects for beginners
- [C++ File Handling](https://coddy.tech/courses/cpp_file_handling): C++ file I/O: text/binary files, fstream, error handling

## Data Structures & Algorithms

- [Insertion Sort - DSA Series](https://coddy.tech/courses/insertion_sort__dsa_series): Insertion Sort algorithm tutorial covering time complexity and DSA
